ctx.x: Look at those guys! And I don’t wanna jump ahead, but in 1957, I got an album here, which says, Joachim Berendt wrote some liner notes about that appearance that the Quartet made in Donaueschingen at the mouth of the Danube in the Black Forest in Schwarzwälder in Deutschland, in Germany, and they had jazz of a sort there, according to these notes, in a few years up until that time. But the Modern Jazz Quartet was in 1957, we were the first jazz really that they had along with Henry Hodeir, with the French jazz…
